summary: Opening Stock imports XLSX files safely, exchange rates cover USD and EUR, and Products gain an operational item card.
highlights: Opening Stock validates and previews XLSX creates, updates and conflicts before finalizing stock.
Manual, official and black-market exchange-rate views now cover both USD and EUR.
Product View shows variants, prices, stock and recent ledger movements in a dedicated card.
Inventory Valuation adds stock value at selling price, expected profit and margin.
New purchase invoices no longer truncate the exchange rate to a whole number in Arabic.
Quantity fields step by 1, and the mouse wheel no longer changes any number field.
